alkylation reagent: followed by alkylation with 10 mM iodoacetamide for 30 minutes
alkylation concentration: followed by alkylation with 10 mM iodoacetamide for 30 minutes
cleavage agent: digested overnight at room temperature with Lys-C (1:200 enzyme to protein ratio) followed by dilution to 1.5M urea and 4 hour digestion with trypsin (1:200 enzyme to protein ratio).
collision energy: Normalized collision energies were set to 25%.
fractionation method: HEK293 cell peptides were separated by basic pH reverse phase fractionation
fragmentation method: top 20 most abundant ions were selected for isolation and fragmentation by HCD.
instrument: Basic pH reverse phase fractions from HEK293 cells were analyzed on a Q-Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer.
ionization type: peptide partially fragments during the electrospray ionization process
labeling: The 24 raw mass spectrometry data files (.raw) from HEK293 cells are available upon request and have been deposited into ProteomeXchange (PXD001468).
reduction reagent: The lysate was reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol for 30 minutes
reduction concentration: The lysate was reduced with 5 mM dithiothreitol for 30 minutes
